result.instructions: Tools for Zenventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items are at or below their reorder level right now?"; "Show me the open customer orders and their items."; "Find the item with SKU ABC-123 and show its price and stock.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zenventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenventory_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenventory_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenventory_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zenventory_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenventory_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: Lists inventory items (products) with optional search and filters. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /items.

searchFor.description: Matches item SKU, UPC or description (exact or partial).

clientId.description: Only items of this client id.

clientName.description: Only items of the client with this name.

active.description: true = active items only, false = inactive items only.

orderDir.description: Sort direction. Used only when orderBy is set (default asc).

tools.name: zenventory_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Gets one inventory item by id, optionally with its units and bill of materials. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /items/{id}.

includeUnits.description: Include the item's units of measure.

includeBom.description: Include the bill of materials for kits and assemblies.

tools.name: zenventory_list_inventory
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: Lists stock levels per item and warehouse, with optional filters for stock and low stock. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /inventory.

searchFor.description: Matches item SKU, UPC or description.

warehouseId.description: Only stock in this warehouse id.

warehouseName.description: Only stock in the warehouse with this name.

inStock.description: true = items with stock on hand.

lowStock.description: true = items at or below their reorder level.

orderDir.description: Sort direction. Used only when orderBy is set (default asc).

tools.name: zenventory_list_customer_orders
tools.title: List customer orders
tools.description: Lists customer orders, optionally only open, completed, draft or cancelled ones. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /customer-orders.

tools.name: zenventory_get_customer_order
tools.title: Get a customer order
tools.description: Gets one customer order by id, with its items and addresses. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /customer-orders/{id}.

includePickedItemMetadata.description: Include picking details for each item.

tools.name: zenventory_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: Lists purchase orders to suppliers, optionally filtered by supplier, order number or status. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /purchase-orders.

supplierId.description: Only orders for this supplier id.

supplierName.description: Only orders for the supplier with this name.

orderDir.description: Sort direction. Used only when orderBy is set (default asc).

tools.name: zenventory_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: Gets one purchase order by id, with its items. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /purchase-orders/{id}.

tools.name: zenventory_list_transfer_orders
tools.title: List transfer orders
tools.description: Lists stock transfer orders between warehouses, optionally filtered by warehouse or status. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /transfer-orders.

originWarehouseId.description: Only transfers from this warehouse id.

destinationWarehouseId.description: Only transfers to this warehouse id.

orderDir.description: Sort direction. Used only when orderBy is set (default asc).

tools.name: zenventory_get_transfer_order
tools.title: Get a transfer order
tools.description: Gets one transfer order by id, with its items. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /transfer-orders/{id}.

tools.name: zenventory_list_cycle_counts
tools.title: List cycle counts
tools.description: Lists stock counts (cycle counts), optionally filtered by type, warehouse or status. Read-only. Zenventory API: GET /cycle-counts.

warehouseId.description: Only counts in this warehouse id.

tools.name: zenventory_create_item
tools.title: Create an item
tools.description: CREATES a new inventory item (a new SKU) in the company's Zenventory account. It stays in the account until someone edits or deletes it in Zenventory. Zenventory API: POST /items.

sku.description: New item SKU. Must be unique in the account.

baseUom.description: Base unit of measure, for example each.

active.description: Whether the item is active (default set by Zenventory).

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id to assign the item to.

reorderLevel.description: Stock level that triggers a reorder.

tools.name: zenventory_create_customer_order
tools.title: Create a customer order
tools.description: CREATES a customer order. It is saved as a DRAFT unless saveAsDraft is false; a non-draft order can trigger fulfilment and customer notices, so set saveAsDraft false only on purpose. Zenventory API: POST /customer-orders.

id.description: Existing customer id. Leave out to create a new customer.

clientName.description: Client (customer account) name, when the account has several.

internalNote.description: Internal note, not shown to the customer.

saveAsDraft.description: true = save as a draft (default true).

tools.name: zenventory_cancel_customer_order
tools.title: Cancel a customer order
tools.description: CANCELS a customer order. This changes the order's status in Zenventory and cannot be undone from this tool. Zenventory API: PUT /customer-orders/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: zenventory_create_purchase_order
tools.title: Create a purchase order
tools.description: CREATES a purchase order to a supplier. It is saved as a DRAFT unless draft is false; a sent order commits the company to the supplier, so set draft false only on purpose. Zenventory API: POST /purchase-orders.

supplierName.description: Supplier name, as it appears in Zenventory.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse id that receives the goods.

warehouseName.description: Warehouse name that receives the goods.

requiredByDate.description: Date the goods are needed, as the Zenventory API accepts it.

items.description: Order lines. Leave out to create an order without lines.

draft.description: true = save as a draft (default true).

prompts.name: add_a_new_sku
